title: diplacus compactus
intro: Diplacus compactus, commonly known as Chinese foxglove or Compact Foxglove, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. The health benefits of Diplacus compactus include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, while also exhibiting antibacterial and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to relax the nervous system and reduce stress, as well as its potential to aid in the treatment of insomnia and anxiety disorders. Diplacus compactus contains bioactive constituents such as iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
